### BikeShare Analysis Project


### BikeShare is a tool to analysis the data generated by bikesharing service in three different cities: chicago, new york and washington. It is a powerfull tool to interact with using comands from your PC. Statistics are automatically generated when you ask for them.

### Files used
bikeshare.py --> Here is the code in Python Programming Language
chicago.csv --> Data from Chicago city
new_york_city.csv --> Data from New York city
washington.csv --> Data from Washington city
